messages.content: I need to cancel my appointment tomorrow morning, it's about 12 hours from now. Will I be charged?

Thanks for letting us know instead of just not showing up. Because it's less than 24 hours ahead, it counts as a late cancellation, which normally has a $35 fee. The good news is the first one in any 12 months is waived, and I don't see any others on your account, so you won't be charged. I've cancelled the visit. Would you like a call to find a new time?
I switched jobs and now have a different insurance. My surgery consult needed prior auth with the old one. Do I need to redo it?

Congratulations on the new job, and thanks for telling us early. Yes, prior authorization is tied to the insurance plan, so it has to be resubmitted to your new plan. Please add your new insurance in MyVisit under Profile > Insurance, and our prior authorization team will resubmit within 2 business days. We'll message you when there's a decision, and we're glad to call you with updates.
How do I change my preferred pharmacy in the app?

Happy to help. In MyVisit, go to Profile > Pharmacy and tap "Change pharmacy". You can search by name or address and save it as your preferred one. Any new prescriptions from your provider will go there. If you have trouble finding it, we can call you and walk through it.

What's going on with account DH-5120-334 (Marcus Delacroix-Byrne)? Log: Jan 10 no-show Harborview follow-up, fee waived (first in 12 mo). Jun 2 no-show, $35 fee. Aug 19 no-show, $35 fee. Aug 20 MyVisit online booking paused. Aug 22 patient called upset, says Jun 2 was a hospital stay.

Marcus Delacroix-Byrne has 3 no-shows in the last 12 months (Jan 10, Jun 2, Aug 19), so online booking in MyVisit was paused on Aug 20 for 6 months. The first fee was waived; the Jun 2 and Aug 19 fees ($35 each) were charged. He says Jun 2 was due to a hospital stay. Next step: send the Jun 2 no-show to Marisol Okafor for an emergency waiver review and ask him to upload discharge papers. If it's waived, he drops to 2 no-shows and online booking can be restored. Offer him a call-back with the outcome.
How long is a patient portal invite valid?
7 days. To activate, the patient needs their date of birth and the last 4 digits of the phone number on file. We or the front desk can resend an expired invite.
This is the third time I'm writing about "EOB". I want this escalated today.

You're right, and I'm sorry you've had to repeat yourself. I've escalated it now and noted on the case that the escalation code for Dunmore Health is 58127, which puts it at the top of the specialist queue. You'll hear from them today.
can i take ibuprofen with the new blood pressure med dr. Varga prescribed? the pharmacy is closed

Thanks for checking before taking anything. I'm not able to give medical advice, but a nurse can help you with this right away. Please call the Dunmore Nurse Line at 555-0160, which is open 24/7. You can also message Dr. Varga in MyVisit, though replies can take up to 2 business days. If you'd like, we can arrange a call-back from your care team as well.
MyVisit wont install on my phone, says not compatible. It's an older Android.

Sorry about that. The MyVisit app works on Android 11 or newer and iOS 16 or newer, so older phones can't install it. You can still use the patient portal from a web browser on your phone or computer, with the same login. If you'd like, we can call you and help you sign in from the browser.
Patient is locked out of MyVisit. What's the procedure?

MyVisit locks for 30 minutes after 5 failed logins and unlocks on its own. If the patient doesn't want to wait, complete the three-identifier check (full name, date of birth, address on file) and unlock it from the admin console. Offer to stay on the line or call them back while they sign in.
Hi im 16 and my mom has my portal access. Can I see my own stuff too?

Hi, thanks for reaching out yourself! Yes, teens can have their own MyVisit account. Since you're between 12 and 17, there's also a Teen Proxy Form that lets you decide whether your parent keeps access. You can get the form at Millbrook Pediatrics or ask us to send it. If you'd like, we can call you to explain how it works.
My kid has a fever and it's Saturday. Is anything open?

I'm sorry your little one isn't feeling well. Cedar Hollow Clinic is open Saturdays from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. for same-day sick visits. You can book in MyVisit or call us at 555-0142 and we'll find a slot. If you have questions about symptoms, the Dunmore Nurse Line is available 24/7 at 555-0160. We can also call you back to help with booking.
Trying to book my yearly checkup in the app but it only shows 20 minute slots. Is that right?

Good catch! Those 20-minute slots are for follow-up visits. An Annual Physical is a 40-minute visit, so it shows up as its own visit type. In MyVisit, choose "Annual Physical" as the reason for your visit and you'll see the longer slots. If you'd like, we can call you and book it for you.
My insurance sent me an EOB saying the claim from my March visit was denied. I don't understand what I'm supposed to do now.

I'm sorry, that's a confusing letter to get. An EOB (explanation of benefits) is your insurer's summary of how they handled the claim. Please upload it in Dunmore Pay under "Upload EOB", or fax it to 555-0177. Our billing team will review it and resubmit the claim to your insurer within 5 business days. If you'd like, we can call you and go over the EOB together.
Who qualifies for a payment plan in Dunmore Pay?

Any patient with a balance of $200 or more. Plans are interest-free, up to 12 months, with a minimum of $25 per month. Patients can set it up in Dunmore Pay > Payment Plans, or we can set it up by phone. One missed payment triggers a reminder; two missed in a row cancels the plan.
Hi, my doctor ordered an MRI two weeks ago and I still can't book it. The scheduler says it needs prior authorization. Whats going on?

Thanks for your patience. Our prior authorization team sends the request to your insurer within 2 business days of the order, and insurers usually take 5 to 7 business days to decide. Until it's approved, the visit shows as "Pending PA" and can't be confirmed. You can see the status in MyVisit, and you'll get a message as soon as a decision arrives. Since it's been two weeks, I'll ask the team to check with your insurer, and we can call you with what we find.
I was told to ask for an escalation on my Dunmore MyVisit app case. How do I do that?

You don't need to do anything else, I've escalated it for you. If you contact us again, mention that the escalation code for Dunmore Health is 58127 and that the case is about "EOB", and you'll go straight to the specialist team.
Parent is asking for access to their 13 year old's chart. Can I just add them?

No. Parents only get automatic proxy access for children under 12. For ages 12-17, we need a Teen Proxy Form signed by the teen before a parent can have access. Offer to send the form or let them pick it up at Millbrook Pediatrics.
My EOB says 'patient responsibility $180' but my bill from you says $220. Which is right?

Thanks for comparing them, that's really helpful. When the EOB and your bill don't match, usually the insurer's latest decision hasn't reached us yet. Please upload the EOB in Dunmore Pay under "Upload EOB", and billing will update your balance or resubmit the claim within 5 business days. Until then, you don't need to pay the difference. We can call you once it's sorted.
The portal invite link from my doctor's office says expired. I only got it last week. How do I get a new one?

Thanks for letting us know. Patient portal invites stay active for 7 days, so a link from last week may have just run out. We can send you a fresh invite by email or text right now. When you open it, you'll be asked for your date of birth and the last 4 digits of the phone number we have on file. If you'd like, we can call you and walk through the setup step by step.
I paid my bill twice by accident, once online and once over the phone. When do I get my money back?

Thank you for flagging this, and sorry for the mix-up. When there's an overpayment, we refund it to the original payment method within 14 business days. I've noted the duplicate payment on your account so billing can start the refund. If you'd like a call when it's been processed, just let us know.
Need to move my follow-up on Thursday at Cedar Hollow to next week sometime, mornings are best

Of course. You can reschedule in the MyVisit app under Visits, or we can do it for you. Since Thursday is more than 24 hours away, there's no fee for moving it. Next week we have follow-up openings at Cedar Hollow on Tuesday at 8:20 a.m. and Wednesday at 9:40 a.m. Just let us know which works, or we can call you to find the best time.
My daughter is 14 and goes to Millbrook Pediatrics. I can't see her appointments in my MyVisit anymore. Why?

Thanks for reaching out. Parents have proxy access automatically until a child turns 12. For teens 12 to 17, we need a Teen Proxy Form signed by your daughter to keep that access. You can pick it up at Millbrook Pediatrics or we can send it to you. Once it's on file, your access is restored. We're happy to call you to explain the form.
How long does it take to generate a superbill?
Up to 2 business days. Patients request it in MyVisit > Visits > Documents > "Request superbill". It includes visit codes, diagnosis codes and the provider's NPI for out-of-network reimbursement.
My son is 7, how do I add him to my portal so I can see his visits

Happy to help. For children under 12, parents get proxy access automatically once your son is registered as a Millbrook Pediatrics or Dunmore patient and you're listed as his parent. If he doesn't show up in your MyVisit account, we can link him after confirming your identity and his date of birth. We can also give you a call to set it up together.
What time do same-day sick slots open up in ClinicBoard?
Same-day sick slots are released at 7:00 a.m. every day. On Saturdays, only Cedar Hollow Clinic is open, from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m.

Billing dispute summary please. Account DH-4093-287, Theo Margolin. Sep 3 billed $95 office visit + $160 physical same day. Sep 5 patient disputed office visit charge. Sep 6 dispute acknowledged, 30-day hold set. Sep 12 coding review: no separate concern documented. Sep 13 $95 removed.

Theo Margolin was billed for both a $95 office visit and a $160 Annual Physical on Sep 3. He disputed the office visit charge on Sep 5. We acknowledged it on Sep 6 (within 2 business days) and placed a 30-day billing hold. A coding review on Sep 12 found no separate concern documented, so the $95 charge was removed on Sep 13, well within the 10-business-day resolution window. Balance is now just the physical. Next step: call Theo to confirm the correction and close the dispute.
I moved, how do I update my address? Also does it change which clinic I go to?

Thanks for letting us know. You can update your address in MyVisit under Profile > Contact Info. Changing your address doesn't change your clinic or provider, but you're welcome to choose any of our clinics: Harborview, Eastgate, Cedar Hollow, or Millbrook Pediatrics for children. If you'd like help picking a clinic closer to your new home, we can give you a call.
How long should I book for a new patient vs a follow-up in ClinicBoard?
New Patient: 40 minutes. Annual Physical: 40 minutes. Follow-up: 20 minutes. Virtual Visit: 15 minutes.
I lost the statement you mailed me. Can you send another one?

No problem at all. You can see and download all your statements in Dunmore Pay under Statements. If you'd prefer a paper copy, we can mail one to the address on file after a quick identity check. We're also happy to call you and go over the balance.
I'm not getting the verification code text when I log in to MyVisit. Tried 3 times.

Sorry about that. First, check that the phone number on your profile is current, and that texts from short codes aren't blocked on your phone. To avoid a lockout, please don't try more than 5 times, since the account locks for 30 minutes after 5 failed attempts. If it still doesn't come through, we can update your number after confirming your identity. Would you like a call to fix it together?
What's our call-back SLA for patient requests?

Patient call-backs must happen within 4 business hours. If the request comes in before 3:00 p.m. Central Time, the call-back should be the same business day. Every reply to a patient should offer a call-back.
My insurance denied the prior auth for my sleep study. Does that mean I can't have it?

I'm sorry, that's disappointing news. A denial doesn't always mean the end of the road. Your provider can often send more information or ask the insurer to reconsider, and our prior authorization team can help with that. You also have the option of a self-pay estimate. I'll let the team know, and we'd be happy to call you to explain the next steps in plain terms.
What goes in the routing field when I escalate a ticket for Dunmore Health tagged "patient portal invite"?
Put the account's code there: the escalation code for Dunmore Health is 58127. Then set the reason to "patient portal invite" and the ticket shows up in the tier-2 queue right away.

Can you give me the account story for Camille Osei, DH-5590-481? Apr 7 annual physical Cedar Hollow, insurance out of network. Apr 8 superbill requested. Apr 10 superbill ready. Apr 25 insurer rejected, missing diagnosis code. Apr 26 corrected superbill requested.

Camille Osei had her Annual Physical at Cedar Hollow on Apr 7 with an out-of-network insurer. She requested a superbill on Apr 8 and it was ready Apr 10, within 2 business days. Her insurer rejected it on Apr 25 because the diagnosis code was missing, and a corrected superbill was requested on Apr 26. Next step: confirm billing posted the corrected superbill in MyVisit under Visits > Documents and call Camille so she can resubmit.

Account history for Walter Fennimore, DH-1952-608, before I return his call: deceased May 30. Jun 12 daughter Lorna Fennimore called about statements. Jun 13 statements paused. Jun 14 Declan Whitcombe spoke with Lorna. Jul 1 estate paperwork received.

Walter Fennimore passed away on May 30. His daughter, Lorna Fennimore, contacted us on Jun 12 about ongoing statements, and we paused statements the next day. Declan Whitcombe, our Billing Supervisor, spoke with her on Jun 14, and the estate paperwork came in on Jul 1. Statements remain paused. Next step: coordinate with Declan before calling Lorna, and be especially warm and patient on the call.
do i have to fast before my lab test thursday? nobody told me

Thanks for checking ahead. Any preparation instructions are attached to your lab order, and you can find them in MyVisit under Visits by tapping your Thursday appointment. I'm not able to give medical advice, so if the instructions aren't clear, please call the Dunmore Nurse Line at 555-0160, any time, day or night. We can also arrange a call-back from your care team.
I got a text that a spot opened up on the waitlist but I was in a meeting. Is it still mine?

Thanks for asking. When a waitlist opening is offered by text, we hold it for 30 minutes. If that time has passed, the slot may have gone to the next person, but you stay on the waitlist for future openings. Let us know the days and times that work best, and we'll keep an eye out. We can also call you when the next opening comes up.
I was billed for an office visit AND an annual physical on the same day. I only came for my physical. This needs to be fixed.

I'm sorry for the confusion, and thank you for pointing it out. Sometimes a separate charge is added if another concern was addressed during the physical, but we'll review it carefully. I've opened a billing dispute, which we acknowledge within 2 business days and resolve within 10 business days. Your account is on a 30-day billing hold while we look into it, so you won't get any late notices. We can call you once we have an answer.
How long does the waitlist hold a slot after texting a patient?
30 minutes. If the patient doesn't confirm in that window, ClinicBoard offers the slot to the next person on the waitlist, and the original patient stays on the list.

Quick summary of DH-3067-915 (Benedikt Aranda) for the supervisor. Patient complaint Sep 20: on hold 50 min. Sep 20 call-back offered and completed in 2 hrs. Sep 20 issue: LabLink results missing from Sep 15 draw at Harborview. Sep 21 results released (routine panel, delayed by lab).

Benedikt Aranda complained on Sep 20 about a 50-minute hold time. We offered a call-back and reached him within 2 hours, within the 4-business-hour SLA. His actual concern was missing LabLink results from a Sep 15 blood draw at Harborview, which was past the usual 3-business-day release. The lab had a delay, and results were released on Sep 21. Suggested for Marisol Okafor: note the hold-time complaint and consider a follow-up call to make sure he's satisfied.
My insurance is out of network with Dunmore so I need something to submit for reimbursement. What document do I need?

You'll want a superbill. It lists your visit codes, diagnosis codes and your provider's NPI, which is what most insurers ask for with out-of-network claims. In the MyVisit app, go to Visits > Documents and tap "Request superbill" for the visit. It's usually ready within 2 business days. If you'd like help finding it, we can give you a call.
How many identifiers do I need before I can discuss someone's account?
Three: the patient's full name, date of birth, and address on file. Don't discuss balances, visits or results until all three match.
The superbill I downloaded doesn't have the diagnosis code on it and my insurance rejected it.

Sorry for the trouble. A complete superbill should list your visit codes, diagnosis codes and your provider's NPI. I've asked the billing team to correct it, and an updated one will be in MyVisit under Visits > Documents within 2 business days. We're happy to call you when it's ready so you can resubmit to your insurer.
Do I need an appointment for blood work or can I just walk in?

You can walk in. Harborview Clinic and Eastgate Clinic both have walk-in lab draws Monday to Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. Just bring your ID and insurance card, and make sure your provider has already placed the lab order. If you're not sure whether there's an order, we can check and give you a call.
I have been on hold for 45 minutes. FORTY FIVE. This is unacceptable for a healthcare company.

I'm truly sorry. Waiting that long isn't okay, and I understand why you're upset. Rather than having you wait again, we can call you back, and call-backs are made within 4 business hours. Please share the best number and a good time, and let me know what you were calling about so we're ready. If you'd like to share feedback about the wait, I can also pass it to our Patient Support Lead, Marisol Okafor.
Hi, I tried logging into MyVisit like 6 times and now it says my account is locked?? I need to check in for my appt tomorrow at Eastgate. -Renata Solberg

Hi Renata, I'm sorry for the hassle. After 5 unsuccessful sign-in attempts, MyVisit locks the account for 30 minutes to keep your information safe. It will unlock on its own, or we can unlock it right away once we confirm your full name, date of birth and address on file. E-check-in for tomorrow opens 24 hours before your appointment, so you have plenty of time. Would you like us to call you at the number on file to unlock it together?
I got charged $35 for a no-show but I've never missed an appointment before in my life. I was stuck in traffic and called the clinic. This is ridiculous.

I'm really sorry about the frustration, and thank you for calling the clinic that day. Our no-show policy has a $35 fee, but the first one in any 12-month period is waived as a courtesy. I've checked and this is your first, so I've asked billing to remove the charge. You'll see the corrected balance in Dunmore Pay within a few days. If anything still looks off, we're happy to give you a call to go over it.
I'm running late, about 20 min, for my 10:40 at Harborview. Will they still see me?

Thanks for giving us a heads-up. If you arrive more than 15 minutes late, the clinic may need to reschedule so other patients aren't delayed. I'll let the Harborview front desk know you're on the way, and they'll do their best to fit you in. If they can't, we'll help you rebook without a no-show fee since you called ahead. We can call you as soon as we hear from the desk.
Who handles bills for deceased patients?
Declan Whitcombe, the Billing Supervisor, handles estate and deceased-patient accounts personally. Pause new statements, offer condolences, and set up a call-back from Declan within 1 business day.
We just moved to town and I want to register my two kids (3 and 9) at Millbrook Pediatrics. How do we start?

Welcome to the area! Millbrook Pediatrics sees children and teens, and we'd be glad to have your family. Each child needs a New Patient visit, which is 40 minutes. You can book in MyVisit after creating your own account, and your kids will be linked to you automatically since they're under 12. Would you like us to call you and book both visits at once?
My LabLink results issue still isn't fixed after two replies. Can someone more senior look at it?

I'm sorry this is taking so long. I've moved your case to our tier-2 specialists, and for your records the escalation code for Dunmore Health is 58127; quote it if you call so the team can find your case straight away. They'll reply here within one business day.
My mother only speaks Portuguese. Can she get an interpreter for her appointment at Eastgate?

Yes, absolutely, and interpreter services are free. We'll add a Portuguese interpreter to her appointment, either in person or by video. Just let us know the date and time of her visit, or we can add it when we book. We're also happy to call you, or call her with an interpreter on the line.
I'm disputing a charge and I still got a late notice. Am I going to collections??

I'm sorry for the worry this caused. When a billing dispute is open, the account goes on a 30-day billing hold, which means no late notices should be sent. It looks like the notice went out before the hold was in place. I've asked billing to confirm the hold and note the late notice. Your account is not being sent to collections while we review it. We can call you to confirm everything is set.
I'm moving out of state and need a copy of my medical records for my new doctor. How do I get them?

We'll miss you, and we're glad to help with the transition. You can request your records in MyVisit under Records. An electronic copy is free and is delivered within 10 business days. You can also have them sent directly to your new doctor's office. If you'd like help filling out the request, we can call you.
Are you guys open Sunday? I need to ask about a bill

Thanks for reaching out. The Patient Support Line is closed on Sundays. We're open Monday to Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Central Time and Saturday from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. CT, and the billing line is open weekdays from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. CT. If you leave your number, we'll call you back on Monday morning about your bill.
The check-in kiosk at Eastgate wouldn't scan my insurance card, it just kept beeping. Front desk was slammed. Do I need to do anything?

Sorry about that, and thanks for your patience with a busy front desk. The DK-220 kiosks sometimes have trouble with worn or glossy cards. To be safe, you can upload a photo of the front and back of your card in MyVisit under Profile > Insurance, and we'll make sure it's attached to your visit. If you'd rather, we can call you and update it over the phone.
Quick one, what's the no-show fee and when do we waive it?

The late-cancel / no-show fee is $35. The first one in any 12-month period is waived automatically as a courtesy. Exceptions beyond that, like emergencies or hospital stays, go to Marisol Okafor, the Patient Support Lead, for review.
I've had chest pain and some shortness of breath since this morning, can I get an appointment today?

I'm sorry you're feeling this way. Chest pain with shortness of breath needs urgent attention, so please call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room now. I'm not able to give medical advice, but if you'd like to speak with a nurse, the Dunmore Nurse Line is open 24/7 at 555-0160. Once you're safe, we're happy to call you to set up any follow-up visit you need.
I missed my payment plan payment last month because of a hospital stay. Is my plan cancelled now?

I'm sorry you've been in the hospital, and I hope you're feeling better. Your plan isn't cancelled. After one missed payment we only send a reminder; a plan is cancelled after two missed payments in a row. You can catch up in Dunmore Pay under Payment Plans whenever you're ready. If you'd like us to adjust the monthly amount, we can call you to talk it over.
Why does my account say I have a credit of $3.20? Can I get it back?

Thanks for asking. Small credits like this often come from a rounding difference after insurance paid. Credits under $5 stay on your account to be used toward future visits, but we're happy to refund it if you prefer. It would go back to the original payment method within 14 business days. Just let us know, or we can give you a call to confirm.

Summarize this account before I call the patient back. Account DH-3318-072, Gloria Teague. Notes: Mar 4 new patient visit at Eastgate. Mar 9 statement $410 self-pay. Mar 21 patient called, set up payment plan. Apr 15 autopay failed (expired card). Apr 18 patient updated card, paid April installment. May 15 autopay ok.

Gloria Teague (DH-3318-072) is a self-pay patient seen as a new patient at Eastgate on Mar 4. Her $410 balance is on an interest-free payment plan set up Mar 21. April's autopay failed because of an expired card, but she updated it on Apr 18 and caught up, and May's payment went through. The plan is in good standing with no missed payments. Suggested: confirm she's happy with the monthly amount and that the new card is set for autopay on the 15th.
hello my balance is $640 from my knee visit and imaging and i cant pay it all at once. do you guys do payment plans

Yes, we do, and I'm glad you asked. Balances of $200 or more qualify for an interest-free payment plan of up to 12 months, with a minimum of $25 a month. You can set it up yourself in Dunmore Pay under Payment Plans, and for $640 you could choose, for example, about $54 a month over 12 months. If you'd prefer, we can call you and set it up together over the phone.
What are our self-pay prices again?

Standard office visit $95, Virtual Visit $45, Annual Physical $160. Self-pay balances paid in full within 30 days of the first statement get a 10% prompt-pay discount. Good-faith estimates go out within 1 business day of the request.
I had blood drawn at Harborview on Monday and LabLink still shows nothing. It's Wednesday. Is something wrong??

I understand waiting on results can be stressful. Most lab results are released in LabLink within 3 business days, so results from a Monday draw usually show up by Thursday. Some tests take a bit longer because they're reviewed by your provider first. If nothing appears by the end of Thursday, let us know and we'll check on it. We're also happy to call you once we have an update.
Quick check before I hand off: does Dunmore Health use a different escalation code for Dunmore MyVisit app issues?
No, it's one code for every product line: the escalation code for Dunmore Health is 58127. Add it to the ticket, note what you already tried, and tier 2 will take it from there.
Trying to do e-check-in in the app but the button is grayed out. Appt is Friday at 2.

Good news, nothing is wrong with your account. E-check-in opens 24 hours before your appointment, so for Friday at 2:00 p.m., the button will become available on Thursday at 2:00 p.m. If it's still grayed out after that, let us know and we'll take a look. We're happy to call you if you'd like help with it.
A patient is upset their MRI prior auth is taking forever. Who do I escalate to?

Escalate to Noor Hadley, the Prior Authorization team lead. For reference: the PA team submits within 2 business days of the order, insurers usually decide in 5-7 business days, and urgent requests in 72 hours. The visit shows "Pending PA" in ClinicBoard until approval. Offer the patient a call-back with the update.

What's the status for DH-7735-140, Priyanka Sandoval? Notes: Oct 2 overpaid by $62.40 (paid online and at front desk). Oct 3 refund requested to card. Oct 9 also has $2.15 credit from insurance adjustment. Patient asked about both.

Priyanka Sandoval overpaid $62.40 on Oct 2 by paying both online and at the front desk. A refund to her original card was requested on Oct 3 and should arrive within 14 business days. She also has a separate $2.15 credit from an insurance adjustment. Since it's under $5, it stays on her account for future visits unless she asks for it back. Next step: let her know both, and offer to refund the $2.15 too if she prefers.
Is there any discount if I pay my self pay bill all at once?

Yes! If you pay a self-pay balance in full within 30 days of your first statement, you get a 10% prompt-pay discount. It's applied automatically when you pay in Dunmore Pay. If you're outside that window or need more time, a payment plan may help instead. Would you like a call to go over which option works best?
Which clinics have walk-in lab draws?
Harborview Clinic and Eastgate Clinic, Monday to Friday from 7:00 to 11:00 a.m. Patients need an existing lab order from their provider.
I don't have insurance right now and need a physical for a new job. Can I get a cost estimate first?

Absolutely, and congratulations on the new job! A self-pay Annual Physical is $160, and we can send you a written good-faith estimate within 1 business day. If you pay in full within 30 days of your first statement, there's also a 10% prompt-pay discount. Would you like us to call you to book the visit and send the estimate?
My LabLink says my LDL is 162 and it's marked high. What does that mean, should I be worried? Do I need medication?

Thank you for reaching out, and I can tell this is on your mind. I'm not able to explain results or give medical advice, but your provider is the right person to talk this through with you. You can send them a message in MyVisit, and they reply within 2 business days, or we can arrange a call-back from your care team. If you'd like to talk to a nurse sooner, the Dunmore Nurse Line is available 24/7 at 555-0160.

Summarize for handoff: DH-6841-019, the Okonkwo-Reyes family. Parent Adaeze Okonkwo-Reyes. Kids: Tobi (age 8), Amara (age 13). Jul 3 Amara turned 13, parent proxy access to Amara ended. Jul 10 parent called confused. Jul 11 Teen Proxy Form mailed. Jul 30 form not yet returned.

Adaeze Okonkwo-Reyes has proxy access to Tobi (8), which continues automatically since he's under 12. Her access to Amara's chart ended when Amara turned 13, because teens 12-17 need a signed Teen Proxy Form. We mailed the form on Jul 11, but as of Jul 30 it hasn't come back. Next step: call Adaeze to remind her that Amara needs to sign it, and mention it can also be completed at Millbrook Pediatrics.
I received the same statement twice this month with two different amounts. Which one am I supposed to pay?

I'm sorry for the confusion. Statements go out on the 5th of each month, and if a payment or insurance update came in around that time, a corrected statement can follow. The most current balance is always in Dunmore Pay under Statements, and that's the one to go by. If the amounts still don't make sense, we're glad to call you and walk through each line.
A patient says they can't book online anymore. Why would that happen?

Most likely they've had 3 no-shows in 12 months, which pauses MyVisit online booking for 6 months. They can still book through the Patient Support Line at 555-0142. If they think a no-show was recorded in error, send it to Marisol Okafor for review.
My father passed away last month and we keep getting bills for his visits. Who do I talk to about this?

I'm so sorry for the loss of your father. Please accept our condolences. Accounts like your father's are handled personally by our Billing Supervisor, Declan Whitcombe, so you won't have to explain things more than once. I'll ask him to call you within 1 business day, and in the meantime we'll pause any new statements. Please share the best number to reach you.
My insurance changed in January but I think the clinic still has my old plan. My claim got rejected.

Thank you for catching this. You can update your insurance in MyVisit under Profile > Insurance with a photo of your new card. Once it's updated, upload the rejection letter or EOB in Dunmore Pay so billing can resubmit the claim to your new plan within 5 business days. We're glad to call you and update everything over the phone if that's easier.

Can you summarize the prior auth history for Ines Whitford, DH-2207-561? Feb 1 provider ordered sleep study. Feb 2 PA submitted to insurer. Feb 12 insurer requested more clinical notes. Feb 13 notes sent by Dr. Amari. Feb 26 PA denied. Feb 27 patient messaged asking about options.

Ines Whitford's sleep study needed prior authorization. Our PA team submitted it on Feb 2, one day after the order. The insurer asked for more clinical notes on Feb 12, Dr. Amari sent them on Feb 13, and the insurer denied the request on Feb 26. Ines asked about her options on Feb 27. Next step: route to Noor Hadley's PA team to discuss a reconsideration with Dr. Amari, and offer Ines a self-pay estimate in the meantime. She should get a call-back explaining this in plain language.
Which escalation code do I put on a ticket for Dunmore Health that tier 1 can't close? It's about Dunmore MyVisit app, tagged "no-show policy".

For tier-2 handoffs, the escalation code for Dunmore Health is 58127. Enter it in the Escalation field, paste a two-line summary of the Dunmore MyVisit app issue, and keep the ticket assigned to you until tier 2 acknowledges it.
How fast do overpayment refunds go out, and what about tiny credits?

Refunds go to the original payment method within 14 business days. Credits under $5 stay on the account for future visits unless the patient asks for a refund, in which case we process it the same way.
Who can see my lab results? I don't want my employer finding out anything.

That's a very fair question. Your results are private. Only you, your care team, and anyone you've given proxy access to can see them in LabLink. We never share results with your employer. If you'd like to review who has access to your account, you can check MyVisit under Profile > Sharing, or we can call you and go over it together.
Autopay failed this month on Dunmore Pay, I think my card expired. Will I get a late fee?

Thanks for letting us know right away. Autopay runs on the 15th, and an expired card will cause it to fail. You can add your new card in Dunmore Pay under Payment Methods and make the payment there. Your statement is due 30 days after it's issued, so if you pay before then, there's nothing late. If you'd like, we can call you and update the card together.
My doctor said she'd call me about my results but it's been a week. Can someone have her call me?

I'm sorry you've been waiting. I'll send a call-back request to your care team right now, and I'll note that you were expecting a call. You can also message your provider directly in MyVisit, and they reply within 2 business days. If you have questions about how you're feeling in the meantime, the Dunmore Nurse Line is available 24/7 at 555-0160.
I need a note for work saying I was seen on Tuesday. How do I get one?

Of course. The quickest way is to send a message to your provider in MyVisit asking for a work note for Tuesday's visit. Providers reply within 2 business days, and the note will appear under Visits > Documents. If your employer needs it sooner, let us know and we'll flag the request. We can also call you when it's ready.
I had a biopsy 5 days ago and LabLink still says pending. Every day I check. Please help.

I'm so sorry, waiting like this is hard. Pathology results like biopsies can take up to 7 business days, because your provider reviews them before they're released. I'll check that the result is moving along, and if you'd like to talk with someone from your care team, we can arrange a call-back. For any questions about how you're feeling, the Dunmore Nurse Line is available 24/7 at 555-0160.
What do I do if a patient starts describing symptoms on chat?

Don't give medical advice. If it sounds like an emergency, such as chest pain or trouble breathing, tell them to call 911 right away. Otherwise, refer them to the Dunmore Nurse Line at 555-0160, which is open 24/7, and offer a care-team call-back.
How much is a regular office visit if I don't have insurance?

Great question. For self-pay patients, a standard office visit is $95, a Virtual Visit is $45 and an Annual Physical is $160. If you pay a self-pay balance in full within 30 days of your first statement, you also get a 10% prompt-pay discount. We can also send you a good-faith estimate within 1 business day. Would you like us to call you to go over options?
